detail: 6334 of 6358 team-games have a depth-chart QB1. Weekly charts through 2024 have no publication timestamp, so qb_asof is kickoff minus one hour in America/New_York. The 2025-2026 file has a dt snapshot; qb_asof is the latest snapshot strictly before kickoff. The id is not the passer who played.

nflverse gameday and gametime are an America/New_York wall clock. A missing gametime would be filled with 13:00 Eastern. Aware timestamps are converted to Eastern before the 2027-01-01 cutoff. End-of-game clock expiration is labeled END_OF_HALF. nflverse has no onside_kick column; own_kickoff_recovery marks a kick the kicking team recovered.
